decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Site location plan, Design and Access Statement Flood Risk Assessment and EX 11050/PO1, PO2, PO3, PO4 and PO5 received 20/09/2011)  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The landscaping scheme to the front of the site shown on the approved drawings shall be implemented prior to the occupation of the development and shall be permanently retained unless otherwise agreed in writing beforehand by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The electric entrance gate shall generate noise levels no greater than 10db below background noise levels  unless otherwise agreed in writing beforehand by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Demolition and rebuilding of the existing garage, single storey rear extension, re-landscaping of the front garden and installation of electronically operated gates
